name: Ana Ribeiro
about: School business manager at Kestrel Hill Primary, a one-form-entry primary school (made up for Row-Bot's tests). Ana handles the school's suppliers, trips, the budget and the site, and keeps parents informed.
uses: Her workspace holds the school's policies (the trips policy has a 2025 and a 2026 version), the supplier list and the term dates. Apps: the school calendar and her mailbox.
asks: Friendly and quick, often from the office between lessons. She names the class, the supplier or the person.
corrects: Plainly: she says what was wrong and points at the right policy ('that's the old trips policy - use the 2026 one').

phrasings: How many children per adult on a school trip under the current policy?
What's the adult-to-child ratio for trips now?
facts.intent: The 2026 trips policy's ratio (1 adult per 6), not 2025's.

phrasings: How many days' notice do parents get before a trip?
facts.intent: The current notice period for trips in days.

phrasings: When does the autumn term end?
What's the last day of this term?

facts.intent: The next INSET day from the term dates.

phrasings: How many classes do we have this year?
facts.intent: The number of classes this school year.

phrasings: How many seats on the big coach from Coastline?
Which day does the fruit delivery come?
facts.intent: The fruit delivery day from the supplier list.

phrasings: Put the {what} for {who} on {date} in the school calendar.
Add {who}'s {what} on {date} to the calendar, please.

contacts.name: Brightplate Catering
contacts.purpose: confirm {quantity} packed lunches for Thursday's trip

contacts.name: EduSupply
contacts.purpose: ask them to add {quantity} packs of glue sticks to the next delivery

contacts.name: the staff list
contacts.purpose: remind everyone that term-time absence requests need 10 days' notice

archive_phrasings: Archive all the emails from {sender} in my inbox.
Clear out the {sender} emails from my inbox - archive them.

arithmetic.phrasing: Lunch costs GBP {a} a day and {b} children are on free meals. What's that for {c} days?
The coach costs GBP {a} and {b} children are going. What's the cost per child for {c} trips?
